summary: A prominent South Korean network for elite engineering students under the [National Academy of Engineering of Korea (NAEK)](https://www.naek.or.kr/en).

A prestigious one-year undergraduate leadership and scholarship program run by the [Korea Foundation for Advanced Studies (KFAS)](https://www.kfas.or.kr/) to cultivate practical problem-solvers who create social value.
Elected as the 12th president of a humanities talent-nurturing scholarship program hosted by the [Shinsegae Group](https://www.sikorea.co.kr/company/group).
Full-time mentor at HAFS Camp, a premier English and leadership camp held at the [Yongin Hankuk Academy of Foreign Studies](https://hafs.hs.kr/).
